# MIT Learn

> MIT Learn offers world-class online courses, professional certificates, and non-degree learning programs across diverse subjects including AI, engineering, business, and sustainability.

MIT Learn provides access to MIT's educational expertise through flexible online learning formats. The platform aggregates courses from MIT's schools and departments, with particular strength in technical fields like machine learning, data science, and engineering, alongside business, humanities, and sustainability topics.

## Key Topics

- Machine Learning
- Python
- AI and Generative AI
- Professional Certificates
- Data Science and Analytics
- Engineering and Systems
- Online Learning
- Leadership Development
- Sustainability and Climate
- Entrepreneurship
- Hands-on Learning
- Cybersecurity
- Supply Chain Management
- Non-degree Programs
- Lifelong Learning

## Course Topics & Subject Areas

- [Data Science, Analytics & Computer Technology](https://learn.mit.edu/c/topic/data-science-analytics-computer-technology): Data Science and AI courses including Python, machine learning, and generative AI
- [Engineering](https://learn.mit.edu/c/topic/engineering): Engineering courses covering AI, robotics, and systems engineering
- [Business & Management](https://learn.mit.edu/c/topic/business-management): Business & Management courses with leadership and digital transformation
- [Science & Math](https://learn.mit.edu/c/topic/science-math): Science & Math courses including STEM, physics, and machine learning
- [Energy, Climate & Sustainability](https://learn.mit.edu/c/topic/energy-climate-sustainability): Energy, climate and sustainability courses including green infrastructure
- [Innovation & Entrepreneurship](https://learn.mit.edu/c/topic/innovation-entrepreneurship): Innovation & Entrepreneurship with generative AI and product design
- [Health & Medicine](https://learn.mit.edu/c/topic/health-medicine): Health & Medicine courses with AI/ML and medical technology focus
- [Art, Design & Architecture](https://learn.mit.edu/c/topic/art-design-architecture): Art, Design & Architecture courses including urban planning and design
- [Humanities](https://learn.mit.edu/c/topic/humanities): Humanities courses in philosophy, language learning, and cultural studies
- [Social Sciences](https://learn.mit.edu/c/topic/social-sciences): Social Sciences courses in economics, policy, and research methods
- [Education & Teaching](https://learn.mit.edu/c/topic/education-teaching): Education and teaching courses with focus on learning technology

## Course Catalog & Navigation

- [Topics](https://learn.mit.edu/topics): Browse MIT Learn courses by subject topic and learning area
- [Departments](https://learn.mit.edu/departments): Explore MIT departments and schools offering online learning programs
- [Units](https://learn.mit.edu/units): Directory of MIT Learn educational units and course offerings

- [Learn with MIT](https://learn.mit.edu): MIT Learn homepage showcasing online courses and certificate programs
